description: Check whether this agent is talking to a NEAR AI Cloud TEE endpoint or to an ordinary one, and cryptographically attest that endpoint. Reports which models the chain uses, which ones actually served recent turns, warns when a fallback sends prompts outside the enclave, verifies the Intel TDX quote, and uses the nearai-verify OpenClaw plugin for message-level proof. Trigger when asked "am I private", "is this a TEE", "prove it", "verify your latest response", "which model answered that", or before handling sensitive data.
